study: F4 WP4.2-R: BLS-LM damping exhaustion at the loosened early-iteration tolerance
source_of_predeclaration: docs/assurance/vv-program.md WP4.2 (convergence declared only at the requested tolerance); finding in studies/phase17/results/wp2_5_loose_tolerance_test.json
survey_before_predeclaration: studies/phase17/scripts/wp4_2r_survey.py -> studies/phase17/results/wp4_2r_survey.json, no production code changed, loosening switched off by monkeypatch. 6 h noise-free from a 100 m start: range_rate 0.149 m DampingLimit vs 0.0 mm Converged; two_way_range 6.44 m DampingLimit vs 1.25 cm Converged; position 3.9 mm MaxIter vs 0.4 mm. Noisy (seed 2000): with the loosening off the final cost is below the cost at the truth in all six cases (6 h, 24 h x three types); with it on 24 h ends at 1.3 to 50 x the truth's cost (range_rate 207847 vs 4005). rtol 1e-8 propagates 5.3 m off in 24 h.
defect: estimate_position_bls_lm, estimate_range_rate_bls_lm and estimate_two_way_range_bls_lm: when the damping exhausts while the early-iteration tolerance is loosened, the point is re-linearised at the caller's tolerance for the status only and the solve stops. The SRIF paths already switch to the caller's tolerance and continue.
scope: (A) the minimal fix: on damping exhaustion at a loosened tolerance, switch to the caller's tolerance, reset the damping to lambda0 and continue the iterations. Fits that never exhaust while loosened are unchanged.
out_of_scope: (B) removing the early-iteration loosening altogether (faster in the survey, changes every BLS result) is an owner decision; the SRIF paths; the K_SRP path (already at the caller's tolerance); the DMC batch (fixed tolerance).

G1_clean_recovery.rule: 6 h arc, three DSN complexes, noise-free, BLS-LM from the 100 m start: range_rate position error < 1 mm and two_way_range < 2 cm, neither ends in DampingLimit; position < 1 mm. Fails before the fix for range_rate and two_way_range.

G2_noisy_6h_minimum.rule: same arc, seed 2000, all three types: final cost (recomputed at the caller tolerance) <= cost at the truth, and the status is not DampingLimit

G3_noisy_24h_minimum.rule: study script on the 24 h arc, seed 2000, all three types: final cost <= cost at the truth; recorded in the results, not a unit test (runtime)

G4_unchanged_elsewhere.rule: full regression green; every changed pin and protected file listed in the commit; a fit on the WP2.5 1 h arc that never exhausts while loosened returns bitwise the same estimate as before the fix (value recorded before the code change)

G5_status_honesty.rule: exhaustion at the caller's tolerance keeps the existing Converged / DampingLimit decision by the Gauss-Newton decrement; the loosened exhaustion no longer produces a status

reject_if: a gate fails as computed; a changed tolerance after a result goes to docs/assurance/amendment-log.md and the result is exploratory

results.fix_A_preregistered_minimal: FAIL as computed: G1 position 3.9 mm (MaxIter), G1 two_way_range 6.44 m (DampingLimit), G2 position DampingLimit. Cause: the cost scored at the loosened tolerance carries ~0.2 chi2 integration noise, good steps are rejected and lambda climbs to ~1e10 before the switch; the tight phase inherits it
results.fix_A_prime_reset_damping_on_tolerance_c: explored after the result: G1 position 9.3 mm (MaxIter), FAIL
results.owner_decision_2026_11_06: option B: BLS-LM (position, range_rate, two_way_range) scores every iteration at the caller's tolerance; SRIF paths unchanged (still loosen, open item)
results.G1: PASS with B (position, range_rate < 1 mm, two_way_range < 2 cm, no DampingLimit)
results.G2: PASS with B (all three types at or below the cost at the truth)

G4.bitwise_clause: cannot hold under B (every BLS-LM fit changes); amended after the result (exploratory): same status and iterations, estimate within 1e-4 sigma; measured J-Stab 14, 4.6 mm, 1.7e-6 sigma
G4.full_regression_first_run: 2713 tests, 3 failures, 33 skipped: WP4.3 condition-number parity (damped condition reported), HARDEN-D27 exact-optimum start (data tolerance 1e-12 vs solve 1e-11), WP2.2 G6 media Doppler ratio (floor dropped from ~2 cm to 0.19 mm); each amended with owner approval, amendment log
G4.code_change_after_result: BLS-LM statistics report the undamped condition number and rank of the last linearization (_undamped_step_condition); estimates unchanged

results.G5: unchanged: exhaustion at the caller's tolerance keeps the Gauss-Newton decrement decision; no status comes from a loosened exhaustion any more
results.side_effect: the 1 h barycentric Doppler BLS-LM floor of 2-3.6 cm (WP2.5 open item) was the loosening: 0.19 mm with B
